cohort: The study included 87 newborns with manifestations of a generalized infectious-inflammatory process (main group) and 30 newborns without infectious and inflammatory diseases (control group).
finding: Neonates with a generalized infectious-inflammatory process exhibited significantly increased levels of cardiotropic biochemical markers, specifically procalcitonin, creatine phosphokinase MB fraction, and troponin I, compared to healthy controls.
cross-section timing: At the time of diagnosis of generalized infectious-inflammatory process/sepsis in neonates.
